item.title: Dozens of Dems flip on Israel, vote to ban arms sales in protest of Iran war
item.summary: More Senate Democrats than ever voted to halt arms sales and military bulldozers to Israel as a protest against President Donald Trump's war in Iran.

item.title: US kills 3 alleged drug traffickers in another Eastern Pacific strike
item.summary: Three alleged narco-terrorists were killed in a lethal strike on a suspected drug-trafficking vessel in the Eastern Pacific region on Wednesday, U.S. Southern Command said.

item.title: Mamdani's wife 'truly sorry' for controversial anti-Israel social media posts
item.summary: Rama Duwaji apologizes for old social media posts featuring racial slurs and praise for Palestinian terrorists in her first interview as NYC first lady.

item.title: Jasmine Crockett doesn't anticipate Trump 'canceling' the midterm elections
item.summary: Rep. Jasmine Crockett, D-Texas, said she does not believe President Donald Trump plans to cancel the midterm elections but expects election interference.

item.title: Justice Thomas warns progressivism is a threat to America in rare public remarks
item.summary: Thomas said Wednesday that values embraced by founders in the Declaration of Independence have "fallen out of favor" and urged Americans to stand up for their ideals and have courage.

item.title: Former Disney teen star exposes chilling warning signs of predatory behavior in Hollywood
item.summary: Former boy band stars Ricky Garcia and Lance Bass shed light on how predators exploit fame and power to target young artists in the music industry.

item.title: Lead contamination crisis exposed in public parks across major southern city
item.summary: An investigation found lead contamination at 50% of New Orleans playgrounds tested, sparking outrage and a push for $5 million in federal cleanup funds.

item.title: Brandi Glanville ends up in urgent care after trying viral TikTok trend
item.summary: Brandi Glanville revealed she spent Easter in urgent care after a TikTok-inspired garlic remedy for her cold went wrong and left a clove lodged in her ear.

item.title: GOP firebrand vows to strip Swalwell and Gonzales of lifetime taxpayer-funded benefits
item.summary: Rep. Boebert announces effort to cancel pensions for Swalwell and Gonzales after both resigned from Congress amid sexual assault allegations.

item.title: Altman attack suspect referenced Luigi Mangione as copycat fears grow
item.summary: Daniel Moreno-Gama allegedly referenced Luigi Mangione before he reportedly firebombed OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's San Francisco home, fueling copycat fears.
